Event · Advanced

Nijmegen Four Days Marches

Four consecutive days of distance, pacing and recovery.

Netherlands · 20–23 July 2027 · 30, 40 or 50 km per day

Organiser information checked 24 November 2026. Dates and rules can change.

What to prepare for

The organiser publishes several daily distance categories and eligibility rules. Plan for repeated days and check the category that applies to you.

Before registering

  1. Read the current distance, age and entry rules.
  2. Check whether your category has equipment requirements.
  3. Plan accommodation, food and recovery between days.

Organiser information

Check current dates, entry rules and availability before booking.
